scope.operation_policy: Do not infer MODIFY from spatial coincidence. MODIFY requires a same semantic slot, explicit old and new objects, substantive old→new semantic or relation change, and closed relation evidence.
scope.speech_policy: Canonical ASR is preserved verbatim for trace only and cannot change operation or supply role, intent, student, or learner claims.

constraints: This is an adjudication intake ledger, not a temporal-board-v2 Gold bundle.
Every group and candidate remains pending until explicit human review and sign-off.
No candidate is accepted; accepted_count must remain 0 before sign-off.
Preserve canonical ASR segment indexes, relative times, absolute source times, and raw text exactly; do not correct ASR.
ASR cannot change the frozen visual operation and cannot supply pedagogical role, teacher intent, student presence, learner observation, or learner effect.
Same space, same slot, handwriting replacement, or textual equality alone never establishes MODIFY.
MODIFY requires old/new objects, a same semantic slot, a substantive old→new semantic or relation change, and relation closure.
Page changes, scrolling, viewport/zoom changes, toolbars/toolboxes, and pointing-only actions are not board events.
